category_title: Preschool girls performing meanness and aggression through 'sassy girl' play routines
scenario_title: Socio-dramatic play in the dark room and loft area
minimal_context: The student is engaging in socio-dramatic free play with female peers in the dark room and loft area using a mirror and shells.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: What are you girls doing in the dark room with those shells?

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Fixing her hair in the mirror) We're playing sassy girls! They be mean, and selfish, they hurt people. (Gives a loud mocking laugh)

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: What else do sassy girls do?

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: And we're naughty people. Ya ... we sneak up on people in their houses, and take all the people the people like the best away. We'll make Luke eat poison. He will eat it and die. We will trick him.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: I will play with you, but I don't want to be mean.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: They're mean. You can play with us, but you have to be mean! If you're not going to be mean, you can't play with us. (Sticks out her tongue and spits)

task.content: Socio-dramatic play defining the 'sassy girl' role.

context.environment: 'Dark room' area and loft area of the classroom
context.social_setting: Free play with a core group of female peers

challenging_behavior_trigger.condition: When the teacher asked to join the play but stated she didn't want to be mean.
challenging_behavior_trigger.observable_behavior: Told the teacher she couldn't play with them if she wasn't going to be mean.
related_quotes: They’re mean. You can play with us, but you have to be mean!

behavior_patterns.condition: When defining the sassy girl role to adults or peers.
behavior_patterns.observable_behavior: Used aggressive facial gestures by spitting and sticking out her tongue, gave a loud mocking laugh, and stated they sneak up on people and take the best away.
behavior_patterns.internal_state: Embodied the role of being naughty and/or mean.
